notes.content:
Hey Pinball Fans!

• CAREER MODE for short, targeted gameplay sessions
• FORCE POWERS to power up your play
• A CANTINA JUKEBOX of John Williams music

Enjoy the discounts, break some high scores, and May the 4th be with you!

notes.title: Our new pinball game, Pinball FX, is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
We are glad to present you our new pinball game! Pinball FX is now available on Steam with more than 100 unique and visually enhanced tables from our library. And there is more to come!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2328760?utm_source=steamnews

Play for free

The game arrives with three free-to-play tables. Discover the castle's dusty cellar and face new challenges on Sorcerer’s Lair, catch the biggest fishes on your way to the top of the leaderboards on Fish Tales™, and play as Cindy, a tough-as-nails frontier bounty hunter in the Old West on Wild West Rampage. 

Complete the tutorial to unlock a 1-day Pinball Pass subscription for free giving you a chance to try more than 70 other tables!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43901061/6b1ab9af260b3759e1618efd179479a2d296c988.jpg

Discover brand new exclusive tables created for Pinball FX and relive the most iconic moments from entertainment powerhouses like Indiana Jones, Star Wars, Marvel, Universal Studios, and many more.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/31647?utm_source=steamnews

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/31645?utm_source=steamnews


Dive into the fantastic universes of brand-new tables like Crypt of the NecroDancer Pinball, Twilight Zone™, and Godzilla vs. Kong Pinball Pack!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2351845?utm_source=steamnews

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2351844?utm_source=steamnews

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2351807?utm_source=steamnews

Enjoy digital pinball at its finest as Pinball FX brings you the most advanced simulation in pinball with Pro Physics for every table in the library, 4K HDR visuals, and ray tracing.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43901061/81b69d2a7af616811733f4cffe721d0f205b0cbe.jpg

Enter the new era of digital pinball and start your conquest on more than 600 different leaderboards!

The Zen Studios Team

notes.title: The brand new free table for Star Wars™ Pinball VR - Droids!
notes.content:
Hey VR Pinball Pals!

We are not done with the surprises, as if you launch Star Wars™ Pinball VR now, you will find a 10th table in your library - Droids - playable as a free update!

[previewyoutube=oa-4yEPtrf8;full][/previewyoutube]
Now, enhanced for VR - the fate of the galaxy rests with C-3PO and R2-D2! Help the friendly Droids with their quest to save the galaxy.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39942376/5add07c9ab1f96bba9e0df96e65b25c2d80765a0.png

Having narrowly evaded the clutches of Darth Vader and the Galactic Empire, our two hapless Droids find themselves scavenged by the Jawas on the planet of Tatooine. Carrying Leia's message for Obi-Wan Kenobi and the vital plans to the Death Star, R2-D2 must escape with the assistance of C-3PO in order to continue his mission.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39942376/75b5ff8bca82a437ab9cdf9c1277669b90f95b4b.png

Table features:
- Help R2-D2 and C-3PO escape the Jawa's Sandcrawler as they join the fun right next to your pinball machine. But watch out for the Jawas!
- Assist other captured Droids to give you perks in the Wizard Mode.
- Use the Sandcrawler's Ore Processor and Magnet Crane mechanisms as playfield toys to start multiball.
- Unlock new Fan Cave customization items - don’t worry, the possibility of navigating through the pinball challenges is not 3720 to 1.

Join the action, and be the first to rule the leaderboards on the Droids table!

notes.title: A new patch is available for Star Wars™ Pinball VR with fixes and Droids table
notes.content:
Hey VR Pinball Pals!

We are happy to inform you that the Droids™️ table has arrived as the second free update, making the library of Star Wars™️ Pinball VR a total of 10 tables! It brings with it a patch with several fixes. Thank you very much to all who reported the issues they encountered! Let's see the list:


 Star Wars™️ Pinball: Droids™️ is now available for free! Join your favorite droids and help R2-D2 rebuild C-3PO!

Have fun playing on the new Droids™️ table!

notes.title: The Han Solo table is NOW available in Star Wars™ Pinball VR as a free update!
notes.content:
Hey VR Pinball Pals!

A surprise is on the horizon in the form of a new table! You can download Han Solo right now as it arrived into Star Wars™ Pinball VR as a free update!

[previewyoutube=pialIw0qgXU;full][/previewyoutube]

Hokey religions and ancient weapons are no match for a good play on the Han Solo table. Relive the adventures of Han and Chewbacca - now in VR!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39942376/91f98ce105bbeaafa68a476d1c028cfb9847e195.png

This pinball table is dedicated to the great Han Solo during the Classic Trilogy era. There are no lightsabers or strangely behaving pinballs here.  Just pure physics and - of course - a good blaster at your side.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39942376/30081d3ad69da220f5b78f600fa299becbc2ccb4.png


Table features:
- Millennium Falcon playfield toy. Place the ball in the secret compartments or fix the hyperdrive!
- Go for high scores as Han and Chewie react right next to you in the VR environment.
- A stop magnet in the first Death Star may capture the ball like a tractor beam.
- Unlock new Fan Cave customization options dedicated to the greatest scoundrel in the galaxy.
- Navigate the dangerous asteroid field as you avoid laser fire in full 360 immersion enhanced for VR.

Jump into the game, and be the first to conquer the leaderboards on the 9th table of Star Wars™ Pinball VR!

notes.title: A new patch is available for Star Wars™ Pinball VR with fixes and Han Solo table
notes.content:
Hey VR Pinball Pals!

We are happy to inform you that besides the arrival of the Han Solo table to Star Wars™ Pinball VR, we have also made many bug fixes! Thank you very much to all who contributed by reporting these issues! Check out this list, this one is quite a beauty:

Main items:
- Star Wars™ Pinball: Han Solo pinball table is now available for free!
- Accessibility menu added in the in-game pause menu. Players can now change their distance, height, and are able to turn on a Tilted View function to reduce neck strain.


Other fixes:
- Fixed an issue where a coin sound was played at the beginning of the game.
- Fixed an issue on the Rogue One table where Mission names appeared incorrectly on the 
Dot-matrix.
- Improved the nudging mechanism which fixed various issues on several tables.
- Exiting a table will no longer initiate a 3-2-1 countdown before the loading screen.
- Moving between tables on the leaderboard is now done via the R stick.
- Fixed an issue where no ball went into the plunger.
- Fixed an issue where unlocked Career missions got locked after pressing Next.
- Multiball upgrade no longer works during Classic mode.
- In Career Mode pressing the flipper button on tables with multiple flipper pads on any sides will no longer decrease the flip counter multiple times.
- "Reset to default" trigger added in the Options / Controls menu.
- Leaderboards will no longer remain in a "forever load" state.
- Players will not shrink down at certain positions in the Fancave anymore.
- Switching to total immersion mode now puts the player in the central position first.
- In the Cantina Jukebox, The Asteroid Field track now plays correctly.
- Slightly dialed down the sound on Rebels.
- Implemented a new Options button on the TV.
- Fixed an issue where the spinners on the Empire Strikes Back table did not register correctly.
- Fixed an issue where credits displayed a missing string.
- Fixed an issue where the Galactic Explorer and Nine Zeros achievements did not work as intended.
- After a mini-game, players will teleport back to a proper position.
- Fixed a visual glitch where the ball reacted unexpectedly to getting near the right flipper.
- Changed Luke’s lightsaber in the Episode VI table model.
- Fixed an issue in Options where the Total Immersion’s button mapping could not be changed.

notes.title: Hotfixes - 4.30.
notes.content:
Hey VR Pinball Pals!

Thank you very much for all the reports and feedback you provided since the release of the game! We are pleased to inform you that we have made the following changes as a result of these. 

- Fixed certain spots in the Fancave where players could fall out from the Fancave.

- Player is now reset to the Fancave when accidentally falling out of it.

- Fixed an issue where the leaderboards would not load entries

- Added an option to sharpen the image in the video settings

- Various bug fixes and tweaks.

We wish you nice time playing and let us know if you would face any difficulties in the dedicated forum thread!

Have a great weekend!

The Zen Team

notes.title: Star Wars™ Pinball VR is finally here! Get on the leaderboards today!
notes.content:
Star Wars™ Pinball VR is now available to play on Steam VR! Jump into a galaxy far, far away once again, and immerse yourself in virtual reality pinball!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39942376/6eddff33588b7825bf28612e0254176a9a861244.png


 The “Fan Cave”: The new home for your pinball table, plus the customizable array of Star Wars lightsabers, blasters, helmets, and more you’ll earn while playing. Start up a new table and life-sized characters and vehicles join you on either side.
 The Mandalorian: The excitement of the first season translated into VR pinball goodness. Take bounties, protect the Child, and meet characters like IG-11 or Moff Gideon. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39942376/542fed09cc0927bf1b1c2cf59df30aa80614ea3f.png


 Total Immersion Mode: Stand side-by-side with your favorite characters and experience everything at table level.
 Full 360-Degree Mini-Games: Dive into iconic Star Wars set pieces like the speeder bike chase on Endor, the Bespin carbon-freezing chamber duel, and others.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39942376/caccc229c3c425bbafe53f7506d140e3034fd75d.png


 Career Mode: Play bite-sized challenges designed to make you a better player! Progress through missions, and become the ultimate pinball wizard. 


In addition, enjoy classic Star Wars™ Pinball features like Force powers, competitive gameplay, haptic controller feedback, your own personal cantina jukebox, and more!

The only thing you need to do now is don your VR headset, press play, and start getting those jackpots! 

The Zen Team
